Title: Compatibility level 1.2 for Azure Stream Analytics jobs is now available

Body.Content:
Compatibility level 1.2 for Azure Stream Analytics jobs is now available. Upgrade your current jobs now. The compatibility level controls the runtime behavior of an Azure Stream Analytics job. When you create a new job, it will now default to the latest compatibility level.

Learn more.
